site_title: Color Memory — A minimal color memory game
site_description: See a color. Memorize it. Rebuild it. A minimal test of visual memory and perception, scored in perceptual color space.
play_description: Memorize a full-screen color, then rebuild it from memory and see how close you got.
play_og_description: Memorize a color, rebuild it, and score your perception.
home_tagline: How well can you remember a color?
mode_speed_description: The color disappears faster every round.
mode_precision_description: Steady time. Colors get harder to tell apart.
mode_endless_description: Keep going until you stop — or miss too often.

howto_description: Learn to play Color Memory: memorize a color, rebuild it from memory and score how close you got. Modes, scoring and tips.
howto_intro: Color Memory tests your visual memory: you see a color for a few seconds, then rebuild it from memory.
howto_step1_text: A color fills the swatch for a few seconds. Notice its hue, how vivid it is and how light or dark.
howto_step2_text: The swatch goes blank. The rainbow bar picks the hue; the square picks saturation and brightness. With a keyboard, arrows move by 1 and Shift + arrow by 10.
howto_step3_text: Your swatch and the original are laid side by side. You get a score from 0 to 100 and how far off you were in hue, saturation and lightness.
howto_scoring_text: Colors are compared the way the eye sees them (in the OKLab color space), not by their numbers: two colors that look alike score high even if their values differ.
howto_band_nailed: 90 or more: nailed it. The color joins your sample deck.
howto_band_pass: 50 or more: your streak goes on.
howto_band_miss: Under 50: a miss. In endless, three misses end the game.
howto_mode_daily: Five rounds with the same colors for everyone. One game a day, with its own daily leaderboard.
howto_mode_classic: Eight rounds of three seconds each.
howto_mode_speed: Eight rounds; the time drops from 3 to 0.5 seconds.
howto_mode_precision: Eight rounds; each color is closer to the one before, so they get harder to tell apart.
howto_mode_endless: No round limit; the time drops to one second, and three misses end it.
howto_tip1: Start with how light or dark it is: that's what memory keeps best.
howto_tip2: Name it in your head: "faded orange, almost brown".
howto_tip3: Play at a comfortable screen brightness, away from colored light.
